- Overestimate prices after recent spikes; reduce forecast peak values by 5–15% for immediate follow-up periods.
- Underestimate prices during prolonged downward trends; adjust downward bias by 3–8% for 3–7 day horizons.
- Model tends to overreact to short-term volatility; dampen forecast volatility by smoothing 3–5 day moving average before final output.
- When true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, reduce subsequent forecast by 2–5% to avoid persistent overestimation.
- For 30-day forecasts, model often fails to capture mean reversion; apply a 1–3% downward correction if recent 10-day average is above 30-day average.
- Avoid forecasting upward trends after sharp declines; if true outcome shows reversal, reduce forecast slope by 20–40% for next 5 days.
